overview.startPoint: Speak to Brother Kojo in the Clock Tower south of Ardougne.

required.note: Items from the tool belt are not listed unless they do not work or are not automatically added.

items.html: Bucket of water (there is a bucket respawn at the well south of the Ardougne Zoo) or ice gloves
items.text: Bucket of water (there is a bucket respawn at the well south of the Ardougne Zoo) or ice gloves

items.html: Armour for lower-levelled players, to survive a few attacks from a level 67 Ogre.
items.text: Armour for lower-levelled players, to survive a few attacks from a level 67 Ogre.

blocks.html: Talk to Brother Kojo at the Clock Tower located south-west on the path going south from Ardougne Zoo.
blocks.text: Talk to Brother Kojo at the Clock Tower located south-west on the path going south from Ardougne Zoo.

blocks.html: Go into the central room and down the ladder.
blocks.text: Go into the central room and down the ladder.

blocks.html: Go through the northeast passage and look for a tile with four colours.
blocks.text: Go through the northeast passage and look for a tile with four colours.

blocks.html: (You can only carry one cog at a time.)

Enter the northeast door closest to the dark grey tile and go as far east as possible.
blocks.text: Enter the northeast door closest to the dark grey tile and go as far east as possible.

blocks.html: There will be a cog surrounded by fire. With a bucket of water in your inventory or Ice gloves equipped, pick it up.
blocks.text: There will be a cog surrounded by fire. With a bucket of water in your inventory or Ice gloves equipped, pick it up.

blocks.html: Place the black cog on the black spindle, next to the ladder you came down when you entered the dungeon.
blocks.text: Place the black cog on the black spindle, next to the ladder you came down when you entered the dungeon.

blocks.html: Go back to the tile room and head through the door by the red tile.
blocks.text: Go back to the tile room and head through the door by the red tile.

blocks.html: Go to the end of the passage and grab the cog in the room with the ogres.
blocks.text: Go to the end of the passage and grab the cog in the room with the ogres.

blocks.html: Return to the entrance and go up the ladder, to the ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US) and place the red cog on the red spindle.
blocks.text: Return to the entrance and go up the ladder, to the ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US) and place the red cog on the red spindle.

blocks.html: Exit the clock tower.
Go just south of the Ardougne Zoo, near the camel enclosure, in a corner against the fence, and down the ladder.
blocks.text: Go just south of the Ardougne Zoo, near the camel enclosure, in a corner against the fence, and down the ladder.

blocks.html: Follow the path. Push the wall at the end and pick up the cog.
blocks.text: Follow the path. Push the wall at the end and pick up the cog.

blocks.html: Climb the nearby ladder.
Re-enter the Clocktower north of you and climb the stairs to the 1st floor (UK) / 2nd floor (US), and place the blue cog on the blue spindle.
blocks.text: Re-enter the Clocktower north of you and climb the stairs to the 1st floor (UK) / 2nd floor (US), and place the blue cog on the blue spindle.

blocks.html: Return to the basement
Enter the north-west door closest to the white tile.
blocks.text: Enter the north-west door closest to the white tile.

blocks.html: Follow the western passage and pick up the rat poison.
blocks.text: Follow the western passage and pick up the rat poison.

blocks.html: Go up the middle path, and pull the western red lever on the southern wall to so that both prison doors are open.
blocks.text: Go up the middle path, and pull the western red lever on the southern wall to so that both prison doors are open.

blocks.html: Go through the gates and use the rat poison on the food trough, which is on the southern wall.
blocks.text: Go through the gates and use the rat poison on the food trough, which is on the southern wall.

blocks.html: Wait for the game message 'They seem to be dying.' then head through the west gate and pick the cog up.
blocks.text: Wait for the game message 'They seem to be dying.' then head through the west gate and pick the cog up.

blocks.html: Climb up the ladder, enter the clock tower, and climb the stairs to the 2<sup>nd</sup> floor (UK) / 3<sup>rd</sup> floor (US).
blocks.text: Climb up the ladder, enter the clock tower, and climb the stairs to the 2nd floor (UK) / 3rd floor (US).

blocks.html: Place the white cog on the white spindle at the top of the clock tower.
blocks.text: Place the white cog on the white spindle at the top of the clock tower.

blocks.html: Report back to Brother Kojo, on the ground floor (UK) / 1<sup>st</sup> floor (US) of the Clock Tower.
blocks.text: Report back to Brother Kojo, on the ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US) of the Clock Tower.

blocks.html: Quest complete!
